# Vervant PDF API

> Developer-first HTML-to-PDF API for SaaS backends; hosted service is currently in private-beta preparation and not publicly available.

## Product

Vervant is building an HTTP API that converts caller-supplied HTML or reusable templates into PDF documents for invoices, receipts, statements and reports.

Verified prototype functionality includes:
- HTML-to-PDF generation.
- Reusable Handlebars templates.
- API-key creation and revocation.
- Monthly usage limits and generation history.
- Page JavaScript disabled while rendering.
- Outbound and local network requests blocked during rendering.
- A4, Letter, Legal and Tabloid output, margins, background printing and landscape output.
- HTML limited to 1 MB, CSS limited to 256 KB, request body limited to 2 MB, and bounded rendering concurrency.

## Important security limitation

The current runtime launches Chromium with --no-sandbox because its constrained Linux environment cannot start the built-in sandbox. Disabling JavaScript and blocking page network requests reduce attack surface but do not provide full process isolation. The hosted API is not publicly available. Do not send production, personal, confidential or sensitive customer documents. The prototype has not received an independent security audit or certification.

## Availability

The static product website and guides are public. The hosted API, public registration and live payments are not open.
